firstPlayerRule: Choose a Lead Investigator. They reveal the case’s start card and read it aloud, then read the first task so the group can investigate together.
clarifications: This is a cooperative investigation; the Lead Investigator reads the cards and checks answers rather than taking an exclusive first search turn.

fairUse.provenance: Guildhall Games listing https://www.guildhallnc.com/products/micro-macro-crime-city supplies a clean English box render with the first-printing 8+ icon and no 2021 award seals. The creator’s official original German packshot https://micromacro-game.com/packshot%402x.ffb2c84f.jpg shows the same 8+ package layout and artwork before award badges; the English callout is the localized counterpart. Pegasus Spiele’s dated 12 October 2020 launch announcement https://news.pegasus.de/der-spieleherbst-hat-begonnen/ identifies Edition Spielwiese’s original 2020 title as 8+ with 16 cases, matching the publisher-authored English rules ©2020 at https://cdn.1j1ju.com/medias/d2/0d/2b-micromacro-crime-city-rulebook.pdf. The 2021 award-badge and later 12+ box images are different printings and were excluded. The retailer image does not imply a license to reproduce it.
